section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants for a single study, noting that 193 individuals (88 male) were recruited from Yale University and the surrounding community, with a mean age of 22.1 years. Ten participants were excluded from analyses for various reasons, including prior participation in a similar study or exceeding age limits. The authors chose a large sample size due to the exploratory nature of their work and the use of a novel creativity task, specifically a verb generation task, to ensure sufficient power.
